# Logistics 0.2.1-main.2

- Mobile Workspaces has a Transfers panel with native progress, completed activity, and interrupted downloads.
- Mobile File Browser has more readable tiles and simpler item actions. Saved documents are available under Libraries.
- AirPlay can retry at the last confirmed position after wake, with a fix for the HEVC segment error that blocked the reported Apple TV retry.
- Select several files with the leading circles, then Move, Archive or Delete them together. On iOS and Android, hold over a folder to open it during a drag.
- iOS video puts chapter skips beside the timeline, and notebook cutouts wait for the PDF background before copying.
- The Transfers icon next to Server opens an overview. Tap the active transfer for live MB/s and per-file progress. Back returns to the originating folder or the overview. Review Push and Pull changes in native controls, with the option to skip the preview.
- New document and New folder are in the Notes Library sidebar. File Browser details open over the current folder.
- Mobile tiles center the image and two-line filename. Hold still for file actions or move after the hold registers to start a drag. Reader menus focus on the open document.
- Interrupted downloads can resume when an app update moves their verified destination. Discard can clear the saved entry if the destination is unavailable.
- Resumable downloads keep a native stream open per file and still save verified checkpoints.
